data.description:
Located in Alībāg, The Grantley Hotel provides a garden. There's a terrace and guests can use free WiFi and free private parking.

All guest rooms at the hotel are equipped with a seating area. All rooms have a private bathroom with a shower, while selected rooms will provide you with a balcony and others also have city views. At The Grantley Hotel the rooms come with a desk and a flat-screen TV.

At the accommodation you'll find a restaurant serving Indian cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and halal options can also be requested.

Speaking English and Hindi, staff at the 24-hour front desk can help you plan your stay.

Chhatrapati Shivaji International Mumbai Airport is 56 miles away.
This property does not accommodate bachelor(ette) or similar parties.
